install.notes: The card has no install command and the clone has no setup.py or pyproject.toml; native.py imports the clone from its local_path. At runtime the hardware path needs LabJackPython 2.1.0 (my_app/requirements.txt:6) and a U3-compatible system driver: UD on Windows or Exodriver on Linux/macOS (README.md:83-85). The gate never installs or imports the clone.
